name: InstaBids
tagline: Get written bids for home jobs from contractors, from inside your AI assistant.
description: InstaBids is an AI-run marketplace for homeowners and property managers: describe a home job once, by chat or through your own AI assistant, and add photos; contractors bid in writing on the same scope; you choose who gets your number. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it.

install.notes: Hosted remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1); nothing to install locally. On first use, press Authenticate and sign in with your InstaBids account. The assistant can help prepare a job and read your own jobs and bids; only you can send a request to contractors.
